mods.name: Block Info
mods.description:
Unified client + server component for Block Info.

Displays real-time block information at the top of the screen: block name,
whether it is from a mod, plant growth, container contents, furnace smelting
progress and block breaking progress.

The server side only adds furnace/container synchronisation. Both network
channels are registered as optional, so the mod works on either side alone:
clients can join servers without it, and servers accept clients without it.

releases.notes:
1.1.0 — one jar for 1.21.1 through 26.3
This release does two big things: it merges the client and server into a single mod, and it extends support from a single 1.21.1 build to every Minecraft release from 1.21.1 to 26.3 — 16 in total. It also fixes several issues you would actually hit while playing, and adds localization.

Which file do I need?
Every file follows the same naming rule: blockinfo-1.1.0-<Minecraft version>.jar. Pick the one that matches your game version.

For Minecraft 1.21.x (these need Java 21):

1.21.1 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.1.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.1.1
1.21.2 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.2.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.2.0-beta
1.21.3 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.3.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.3.56
1.21.4 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.4.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.4.121
1.21.5 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.5.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.5.74
1.21.6 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.6.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.6.0-beta
1.21.7 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.7.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.7.0-beta
1.21.8 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.8.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.8.9
1.21.9 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.9.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.9.0-beta
1.21.10 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.10.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.10.63
1.21.11 — blockinfo-1.1.0-1.21.11.jar, minimum NeoForge 21.11.42
For Minecraft 26.x (these need Java 25):

26.1 — blockinfo-1.1.0-26.1.jar, minimum NeoForge 26.1.0.1-beta
26.1.1 — blockinfo-1.1.0-26.1.1.jar, minimum NeoForge 26.1.1.0-beta
26.1.2 — blockinfo-1.1.0-26.1.2.jar, minimum NeoForge 26.1.2.71
26.2 — blockinfo-1.1.0-26.2.jar, minimum NeoForge 26.2.0.57
26.3 — blockinfo-1.1.0-26.3.jar, minimum NeoForge 26.3.0.76
Every jar is compiled against the lowest NeoForge release of its line, so it keeps working across that whole line — the 1.21.1 build runs on 21.1.1 through 21.1.264.

Added
Multi-version support — 16 Minecraft releases from 1.21.1 to 26.3, one jar per release rather than one per NeoForge patch number.
Localization — HUD text now goes through vanilla language files. English and Simplified Chinese are built in; adding another language only means dropping in a <locale>.json.
Client and server merged — previously these were two separate projects producing two jars with the same modId, so they could not coexist. One jar now contains both sides.
Fixed

HUD flickering while mining (the big one). mineProgress was being reset by data.clear() inside collectBlockInfo() every 2 ticks, so the progress value and the panel height toggled between zero and the real value at 10 Hz. The mining state is now updated after collection, and bar visibility is driven by a dedicated isMining flag.
Mining progress always zero. It was read by reflecting into ClientLevel$DestroyProgress, a class that does not exist in 1.21.1 — block breaking progress actually lives in MultiPlayerGameMode. Now uses the public getDestroyStage().
Could not join servers without the mod. Network channels were required, so a server without them kicked the client. They are now registered optional(), so a client-only install can join any server.
Item names shown as raw IDs. BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.get(id) returns Item in 1.21.1 but Optional<Holder.Reference<Item>> from 1.21.2 on, which does not compile across versions. Replaced with a registry scan using getKey.

Changed
License unified to Apache-2.0 (README and repository said MIT while Modrinth said Apache-2.0).
HUD drawing rewritten to use only fill / text (drawString), dropping RenderSystem and blit. Progress bars are now solid fills instead of the furnace texture arrow — which is also what makes cross-version compilation possible.
Version number unified at 1.1.0, jar names unified as blockinfo-1.1.0-<MC version>.jar.
Build upgraded — Gradle 9.2 (8.9 cannot resolve the NeoForge 26.x module metadata), JDK 21 for 1.21.x and JDK 25 for 26.x.
Sources are split by version line into common (1.21.1–1.21.10), common111 (1.21.11) and common26 (26.x). They differ only in the API renames each line made; the logic is identical.

readmeSummary: 这个模组最初是为了解决 NeoForge 上准星信息显示缺失的问题而写的：高版本 NeoForge 一直 没有一个能在世界里直接"看着方块看内容"的预览工具。现在它还额外解决了老版本信息类模组在 NeoForge 上不工作的问题。
